_docs.grid: [i, j] on the ceiling coffer grid — i across X (0 = centre line), j rows upstage→downstage from coffer.zOffset. pos [x,y,z] overrides grid.
_docs.angles: pan: degrees about Y, 0 = facing upstage (−Z), +ve toward ladies side (+X). tilt: degrees from straight down, 0 = straight down, 90 = horizontal, >90 tips upward.
_docs.beam: full cone angle, degrees. intensity 0–1 (visual only — no photometry, per SPEC §6).
_docs.fields: type groups the panel (moving head | wash | pixel strip | profile | follow spot). group is the physical position. note carries the request verbatim, including the +km / −km annotations, which are NOT interpreted.
_docs.confidence: every fixture added from the lighting request is c:'est' — positions are inferred from the venue model, NOT surveyed. Measure before plotting.
_docs.assumptions: PS is read as the performance stage (forestage in the venue model) and CS as the ceremonial stage (the main stage carrying the cabin). Confirm before anyone builds from these.
_docs.off: fixtures with on:false are requested but unconfirmed — pending a decision or another department.
_docs.throw: optional metres — draws the cone this long instead of raycasting. For fixtures the raycast cannot reason about: cabin-interior units inside a volume it does not model, and pixel tape, which grazes a surface rather than throwing a beam.
